Rishi — Monica has a warm POC with FinTop. They want a MAP with a stepped discount that could reach 30% if they meet milestone commitments. Details:

- Deal id: FT-2027-042
- Estimated starting volume: 8M tokens/month after ramp (month 2)
- Proposed commercial structure: 6-month paid commitment post-pilot, stepped discounts at pilot acceptance, ramp month 1, and month 3 (10% each).
- Our conservative alternative: 20% max tied to a firm commitment of X tokens (we can define a minimum committed spend).

- Legal to include clawback language if milestones not met.

Markus — Laura is requesting approval for a MAP-linked discount that could reach 30% for FinTop (deal FT-2027-042). I’ve reviewed the numbers and propose the following:

- Approve up to 25% discount contingent on:
  - Signed 6-month paid commitment post-pilot with minimum monthly spend of $35k for the first 3 months;
  - Performance milestones in the MAP with acceptance criteria;
  - Clawback clause if committed volume not met for two consecutive months.

Rationale: 30% would be a stretch given expected unit economics; 25% with firm commitments and clawbacks preserves upside while de-risking revenue. If you want to approve 30% we should require either a longer commit (9–12 months) or a formal rebate/true-up that shifts risk to FinTop.

If you approve 25% I’ll notify Laura and Monica and we’ll update the SOW and procurement play.

Thanks,
